image:image.image:title: AI Agents Are Becoming Operational Capital
image:image.image:caption: A board-level essay arguing that AI agents which encode judgment, process logic, institutional knowledge, and repeatable execution should not be treated merely as tools. Some agents will need to be governed as operational assets, graded by maturity, reliability, risk, value, useful life, and cost displacement.
